mapper.select: SELECT wi.id, wi.key, wi.title, wi.common_status, wi.flagged, wi.block_reason, wi.assignee_id, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - wi.status_changed_at)) / 86400)::bigint AS age_days FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId} AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.draft = false AND wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE', 'HOLD') AND ( wi.flagged = true OR wi.status_changed_at < now() - ((#{sleDays} * 0.8) || ' day')::interval ) ORDER BY wi.flagged DESC, age_days DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT count(*) FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND draft = false AND flagged = true

SELECT count(*) FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId} AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.draft = false AND wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE', 'HOLD') AND wi.status_changed_at < now() - (#{sleDays} || ' day')::interval

SELECT count(DISTINCT al.work_item_id) FROM activity_logs al JOIN work_items wi ON wi.id = al.work_item_id AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.draft = false AND wi.project_id = #{projectId} JOIN workflow_status ws ON ws.code = al.to_value AND ws.workflow_id = wi.workflow_id WHERE al.action = 'STATUS_CHANGE' AND ws.common_status = 'DONE'

SELECT wi.id, wi.key, wi.title, wi.assignee_id, count(*) AS reopen_count FROM activity_logs al JOIN work_items wi ON wi.id = al.work_item_id AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.draft = false AND wi.project_id = #{projectId} JOIN workflow_status wf_from ON wf_from.code = al.from_value AND wf_from.workflow_id = wi.workflow_id JOIN workflow_status wf_to ON wf_to.code = al.to_value AND wf_to.workflow_id = wi.workflow_id WHERE al.action = 'STATUS_CHANGE' AND wf_from.common_status = 'DONE' AND wf_to.common_status <> 'DONE' GROUP BY wi.id, wi.key, wi.title, wi.assignee_id ORDER BY reopen_count DESC, wi.id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT count(DISTINCT al.work_item_id) FROM activity_logs al JOIN work_items wi ON wi.id = al.work_item_id AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.draft = false AND wi.project_id = #{projectId} JOIN workflow_status wf_from ON wf_from.code = al.from_value AND wf_from.workflow_id = wi.workflow_id JOIN workflow_status wf_to ON wf_to.code = al.to_value AND wf_to.workflow_id = wi.workflow_id WHERE al.action = 'STATUS_CHANGE' AND wf_from.common_status = 'DONE' AND wf_to.common_status <> 'DONE'

SELECT wi.assignee_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE','HOLD')) AS in_progress, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE','HOLD')) AS delayed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.flagged = true) AS blocked FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId} AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.draft = false AND wi.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND wi.common_status <> 'DONE' GROUP BY wi.assignee_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.common_status NOT IN ('DONE','HOLD')) > 0 ORDER BY blocked DESC, delayed DESC, in_progress DESC

SELECT t.id, t.key, t.first_done, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.first_done - t.first_ip)) / 86400.0 AS days FROM ( SELECT wi.id, wi.key, MIN(al_ip.created_at) AS first_ip, MIN(al_done.created_at) AS first_done FROM work_items wi JOIN activity_logs al_ip ON al_ip.work_item_id = wi.id AND al_ip.action = 'STATUS_CHANGE' JOIN workflow_status ws_ip ON ws_ip.code = al_ip.to_value AND ws_ip.workflow_id = wi.workflow_id AND ws_ip.common_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' JOIN activity_logs al_done ON al_done.work_item_id = wi.id AND al_done.action = 'STATUS_CHANGE' JOIN workflow_status ws_dn ON ws_dn.code = al_done.to_value AND ws_dn.workflow_id = wi.workflow_id AND ws_dn.common_status = 'DONE' WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId} AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.draft = false GROUP BY wi.id, wi.key ) t WHERE t.first_done >= t.first_ip ORDER BY t.first_done DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT common_status AS commonStatus, count(*) AS count FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND draft = false GROUP BY common_status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_snapshots (project_id, snapshot_date, common_status, item_count) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{commonStatus}, #{itemCount}) ON CONFLICT (project_id, snapshot_date, common_status) DO UPDATE SET item_count = EXCLUDED.item_count
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM projects WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.result = 'PASS') AS passed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.result = 'FAIL') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.result = 'PARTIAL') AS partial, 0 AS passRatePct FROM field_verifications fv JOIN work_items wi ON wi.id = fv.work_item_id AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.draft = false WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT count(*)::int FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND draft = false AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at >= now() - (#{historyDays} || ' day')::interval GROUP BY date_trunc('day', completed_at)

SELECT sc.sprint_id AS sprintId, sc.committed_points AS committedPoints, sc.committed_item_count AS committedItems, COALESCE(SUM(wi.story_points) FILTER (WHERE wi.common_status = 'DONE'), 0)::int AS donePoints, count(*) FILTER (WHERE wi.common_status = 'DONE')::int AS doneItems FROM sprint_commitments sc LEFT JOIN work_items wi ON wi.id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(sc.committed_item_ids)::bigint) AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.draft = false WHERE sc.sprint_id = #{sprintId} GROUP BY sc.sprint_id, sc.committed_points, sc.committed_item_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sprint_commitments (sprint_id, committed_item_count, committed_points, committed_item_ids) VALUES (#{sprintId}, #{committedItemCount}, #{committedPoints}, #{committedItemIds, typeHandler=com.therecommerce.workmap.common.mybatis.scalar.LongListJsonTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (sprint_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT planned_points AS "plannedPoints", planned_start AS "plannedStart", planned_end AS "plannedEnd" FROM project_baselines WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND is_active = true LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(story_points), 0)::int FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND draft = false AND common_status = 'DONE'

SELECT wi.id, wi.key, wi.title, wi.block_reason, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - wi.status_changed_at)) / 86400)::bigint AS wait_days FROM work_items wi WHERE wi.project_id = #{projectId} AND wi.deleted_at IS NULL AND wi.draft = false AND wi.flagged = true ORDER BY wait_days DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE common_status = 'DONE') AS "devDone", count(*) FILTER (WHERE ops_apply_status = 'APPLIED') AS "opsApplied", count(*) FILTER (WHERE ops_apply_status IS NOT NULL) AS "anyOpsStatus" FROM work_items WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND draft = false
